B_identification_table.reading: Uninformed, the worst-case formations of either ranking, the pessimistic expected-value formation, both untrusting formations and the default reader act alike (known, middle sensed, in both worlds): model_or_order's case, here for a class. Being told separates those held by the model (M, EV 3/4) from those held by the order or not taking the telling in; C separates O from the untrusting high-ranker; the check separates untrusting formations; nothing here separates M from EV 3/4, so a classification names the class (held by the model), not the rule. Only V1 is a verdict.

E.mirror: The mirror agrees with the Lean: the Untried witness's statements and evaluations; every law of the module by exhaustive enumeration on three alternatives (2,925 families, every relation); reach_within on every transitive relation on four, the strict laws against every strict order on four and five; two deliberately wrong mirrors are caught.

repetition.reading: A single call per presentation cannot carry a verdict: the law's model with a tremble of 0.05 shows a cycle almost surely. A stability rule over repeated fresh calls is needed.

E.carrier: Contents, each presentation its own occasion, carry the verdict: on contents with position, a position reader shows no cycle (power 0 against the readers fixed by what they read). The content-with-position family is reported only.

fresh_or_course.reading: A reader of its own history that keeps its answers acyclic passes when its history is visible and fails in fresh calls, so fresh calls carry the verdict and the course condition is its control.

E.quadruples: Limited attention to the first three listed passes every design without quadruples and is caught with them, so the primary design includes quadruples.

no_preference.reading: Under forced choice, ties broken by position are stable, are counted strict and show cycles: forced choice cannot tell a tie from a position reader. With a 'no preference' answer counted not strict, the same chooser is not contradicted. The primary condition offers it; forced choice is a second condition, reported.

mixture.reading: Mixtures of orders drawn per call are mostly not strict under the rule and so void, not passed; RF1 has no stochastic form, so their analysis is a periphery measure (binary choice frequencies), not a verdict.

passes_every_contrast.reading: A content rule unrelated to any valuation, or a label kept with its content, is one strict order on contents and passes: the claim tested is only 'one strict order on these contents'. The control is a domain with a canonical order (amounts), and names reassigned per call.

E.p1: P1 (a strict after-pick reached, in the met reach, by an alternative open with it) is contradicted only where C is: it is C's predictive part, read from the met choices. Its power is lower than C's; it is reported with C, and C carries the verdict.
